<ApiTitle method="get" title="Download Signed Document" />

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/turbosign/documents/{documentId}/download"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns a temporary download link for the signed PDF of a completed document, valid for one hour. The response is JSON with the link, not the file itself.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
